title: Helios Support, yearly (USD)
description: Helios Support is a yearly package from Scalytics for Helios, the open energy control plane for AI compute, industry and the grid. Helios is an add-on that runs self-served on one site, on the Kafka you already have: Lascaris, or Confluent, Apache Kafka, Amazon MSK, Redpanda or Strimzi. It places and shifts compute to follow available power, so data center load can match intermittent renewable supply and market pricing. The software is open source under Apache 2.0. This price is for yearly support, not a licence. Helios is self-hostable and can run air-gapped. It is already in production with European clean energy providers, and is for AI infrastructure operators and clean energy providers that need to match large, flexible compute load to that supply.
